old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a person's hands working with clay on a light-colored table. The individual is wearing a dark blue shirt and appears to be in a cluttered workspace, indicated by the presence of plastic bags and other items in the background. The hands are actively rolling a piece of reddish-brown clay into a ball. The table surface shows signs of previous work, with some clay remnants scattered around. In the background, there are plastic bags and other items, suggesting an ongoing creative process. The lighting is artificial and even, highlighting the texture of the clay and the movements of the hands.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a person's hands working with clay on a wooden table. The individual is wearing a dark-colored shirt and appears to be in a pottery studio or workshop setting, indicated by the presence of various pottery tools and materials in the background. The hands are actively shaping and molding a piece of reddish-brown clay, which is being kneaded and pressed into a more defined form. The table surface shows signs of previous work, with some clay remnants scattered around. In the background, there are plastic bags and other pottery items, suggesting an ongoing creative process. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the texture of the clay and the movements of the hands. The overall atmosphere is one of focused craftsmanship and artistic creation.
caption: The video captures a person, visible as forearms, hands and the edge of a dark torso/apron, working reddish-brown clay on a pale pink tabletop. Several crumpled lumps sit in a loose cluster to the right, while a faint clay smear marks the active area at left-center. Both hands repeatedly press, spread, and roll a lump there, its irregular surface gradually becoming a rounded ball. The hands pause over the ball, turning and steadying it. The right hand then carries that ball across the table to the right and sets it down, leaving a smooth ball at the far right. The hands return to a lump at left-center, continuing to press and turn it. The fixed background of plastic sheeting and blurred shelving remains unchanged throughout.
